Hi Alex,

Thanks for the interest — excited to get Clearpath set up. To keep this low-friction for your ops/security folks, can we book a 90-minute walkthrough that covers: DPA items (data flows + retention), SOC 2 controls mapping, and a short discussion of pen-test scope/ops? We find teams either prefer one continuous 90-min session or two 45-min sessions spread across evenings.

Because of your engineering hours, we can offer evening slots (PT) next week. Proposed options (PT):
- Option A: Tue, Jul 27 — 18:00–19:30 PT (single 90-min)
- Option B: Tue/Wed, Jul 27–28 — 18:00–18:45 PT each (split sessions)

If neither works send a couple of windows that do. Attached is a short agenda and a checklist of common evidence items so your team can triage in advance. We'll invite a controls engineer and our pen-test liaison; if you want your pen vendor there, please loop them in.

Agenda (attached): intro -> data handling & DPA -> SOC 2 controls mapping -> pen test ops & evidence transfer -> Q&A / next steps.

Next steps: confirm Option A or B (or propose two slots) and let us know any specific attendees (SSO/contact for evidence transfers).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
